description: Run the schematic layout for one view (the project, or a subsystem's drill-down) and list every block's position and size and every print page's frame, so blocks and pages can be placed without guessing. Block x, y are relative to the block's own subsystem (what set_block_positions takes); ax, ay are absolute in the view (what pages use). Pages are a fixed 1504 × 800 frame; automatic pages (auto:0, auto:1…) cover whatever no placed page holds. Takes a few seconds, up to ~15 s on a large project.

subsystem.description: Subsystem whose drill-down view this is (name or id). Omit for the project view.

name: layout_view
title: Layout of a view
